About the Project

Cyber Roadmap Hub

A collaborative platform for learning cybersecurity through structured roadmaps and community interaction.

What is Cyber Roadmap Hub?

This platform provides a comprehensive cybersecurity learning roadmap, from basic IT skills to advanced certifications. Users can track their progress, access learning resources, and discuss topics with fellow learners in real-time chat.

Features

  • Structured Roadmap: Organized learning path with prerequisites and dependencies
  • Progress Tracking: Mark tasks as completed and view overall progress
  • Real-time Chat: Discuss topics with other learners
  • Resource Links: Curated learning materials for each skill
  • User Accounts: Sync progress across devices
  • Notifications: Get notified of new chat messages

Technology Stack

Built with modern web technologies:

  • Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Backend: Firebase (Realtime Database, Authentication, Cloud Functions)
  • Hosting: Firebase Hosting
